blogPosts.title: Emergency Plumbing in Burwood: What to Do When a Pipe Bursts
blogPosts.excerpt: Learn the immediate steps to take when a pipe bursts in your Burwood home and how Express Plumbing & Gas can help quickly.
body: A burst pipe in your Burwood home can cause significant water damage if not addressed immediately. The first step is to turn off the main water supply to prevent further flooding. Locate the stopcock, usually near the water meter, and shut it off. Then, open taps to drain remaining water and reduce pressure.

Next, assess the damage and ensure safety. Turn off electricity if water is near electrical outlets. Avoid using any electrical appliances. If the burst is severe, evacuate the area and call a licensed emergency plumber. Express Plumbing & Gas offers 24/7 emergency services in Burwood, with rapid response times to minimise damage.

Once the immediate threat is controlled, document the damage for insurance purposes. Take photos and notes before any repairs. Our plumbers at Express Plumbing & Gas will repair the burst pipe using durable materials that comply with Australian plumbing standards. We ensure a lasting fix to prevent future incidents.

Prevention is key to avoiding burst pipes in Melbourne's variable climate. Insulate pipes during winter to prevent freezing, and check for signs of corrosion regularly. Our team provides preventative maintenance services in Burwood to keep your plumbing system in top condition.

blogPosts.title: Signs Your Hot Water System Needs Repair in Melbourne's East
blogPosts.excerpt: Discover common signs that your hot water system is failing and why Burwood homeowners trust Express Plumbing & Gas for repairs.
body: In Melbourne's eastern suburbs like Burwood, a reliable hot water system is essential for comfort, especially during chilly winters. One common sign of failure is inconsistent water temperature. If your showers turn cold suddenly or take too long to heat, it might indicate a failing element or thermostat.

Strange noises from your hot water tank, such as popping or rumbling, often signal sediment buildup. This reduces efficiency and can lead to corrosion. Flushing the tank annually can help, but if noises persist, it's time to call a professional. Express Plumbing & Gas in Burwood offers thorough inspections and repairs.

Leaks around the base of the tank are a clear warning sign. Even small drips can waste water and increase bills. Ignoring leaks can lead to major failures and water damage. Our Burwood plumbers can assess whether repair or replacement is the best option.

Age is a factor too. Most hot water systems last 10-15 years. If yours is older and requires frequent repairs, investing in a new, energy-efficient model might be cost-effective. We supply and install all brands and types, tailored to Burwood homes.

Energy bills creeping up? An inefficient hot water system could be the culprit. Modern systems are designed for lower energy consumption. At Express Plumbing & Gas, we help Burwood residents choose the right system and ensure proper installation for optimal performance.

Regular maintenance can extend your system's life and prevent unexpected breakdowns. Our service includes checking anodes, valves, and connections. For Burwood homeowners, scheduling annual hot water checks with us ensures year-round reliability.

blogPosts.title: Gas Leak Detection and Safety Tips for Burwood Homes
blogPosts.excerpt: Essential advice on detecting gas leaks in Burwood properties and how Express Plumbing & Gas ensures safety with professional services.
body: Gas leaks in Burwood homes are serious hazards that require immediate attention. Signs include a smell of rotten eggs, hissing sounds near gas appliances, or dead vegetation around gas lines. If you suspect a leak, leave the premises immediately and call a licensed gas plumber.

Do not use any electrical switches or flames, as they can ignite the gas. Once safe, contact Express Plumbing & Gas. Our licensed gasfitters in Burwood use advanced detection equipment to locate leaks accurately. We respond quickly to ensure your safety.

Prevention starts with regular maintenance. Have your gas appliances serviced annually by a professional. We check connections, pipes, and appliances for wear and tear. In Melbourne's climate, pressure changes can affect gas lines, so inspections are crucial.

Installing carbon monoxide detectors in your Burwood home adds an extra layer of safety. These devices alert you to dangerous gas buildup. Our team can advise on placement and maintenance as part of our comprehensive gas safety services.

At Express Plumbing & Gas, we adhere to all Australian standards for gas fitting. Our work is fully certified and insured. We provide detailed reports after each inspection, giving Burwood homeowners peace of mind.

blogPosts.title: How Often Should You Clean Your Drains in Burwood?
blogPosts.excerpt: A guide to drain maintenance frequency for Burwood properties, with tips from Express Plumbing & Gas to prevent blockages.
body: In Burwood, where tree roots and soil conditions can affect drainage, regular drain cleaning is vital. Most experts recommend cleaning household drains every 3-6 months to prevent buildup of hair, grease, and debris. This simple maintenance avoids costly blockages.

For kitchen sinks, avoid pouring fats and oils down the drain, as they solidify and cause clogs. Use drain strainers to catch food particles. Regular hot water flushes can help dissolve minor grease buildup. Our Burwood plumbers can perform professional cleanings.

Bathroom drains, especially in showers and bathtubs, accumulate soap scum and hair. Weekly cleaning with natural solutions like baking soda and vinegar can keep them clear. However, if slow drainage occurs, it's time for a professional check.

Outdoor drains in Burwood properties need attention too, especially after storms. Leaves and garden debris can block stormwater drains, leading to flooding. We recommend inspecting and cleaning these drains seasonally.

Express Plumbing & Gas offers comprehensive drain cleaning services in Burwood. Using high-pressure water jetting, we remove stubborn blockages and buildups. Our CCTV inspections identify underlying issues like root intrusion.
Establishing a regular drain maintenance schedule with us ensures your Burwood property remains free-flowing and prevents emergency call-outs. Contact us for a tailored maintenance plan.
